notes: Each case mirrors one Auto-routing call: the router agent (dochaus/agent/router.md) receives the candidate list, a little history, and the user's message, and must reply with exactly one candidate name. `candidates` entries must be real agent ids in dochaus/agent/ — run.ts resolves their descriptions from the agent frontmatter at runtime, so fixtures never go stale against the prompt the router actually sees (apps/web/src/api/opencode.ts routePrompt builds '<candidates>/<history>/<message>'). `candidates` must equal the CHAT_ASSISTANTS set in apps/web/src/agents.ts — the production routing candidates — and be updated in the same commit when that set changes. `rule` cites the first-match rule in router.md that decides the case.
